// The closest pair between two indexed sets
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Closest_pair_of_points_problem): IndexA into
// the first set, IndexB into the second, and the separating distance (0 when
// touching or overlapping).
type ClosestPairResult
    implements IValue
{
    IndexA: ItemIndex;
    IndexB: ItemIndex;
    Distance: Number;
}
